patches.value: Under L1, sup_(t in I)||integral_a^t J_s(Rres',V)ds||_2<=C_(gamma,M0)*(h+tau)*(tau^gamma+E_I). All constants in this bound and the endpoint, cubic, low-frequency and accumulated residual bounds can be dominated by a single positive constant depending only on gamma,M0, uniformly over admissible trajectories, intervals, timesteps and thresholds N>=2.
